name: Valkyn Skoria (person)
location: City of Ash II, Red-Zeal Keep

abilities.name: Flame Strike
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that deals minor flame damage.

abilities.name: Meteor Strike
abilities.description: A heavy melee attack that deals high physical damage.

abilities.name: Fire Stab
abilities.description: The boss summons a flaming pool at its location that releases lines of flame dealing moderate flame damage. Stay away from it to avoid the fire lines.

abilities.name: Platform Detonation
abilities.description: After an amount of time, he will move to the center of the platform he's standing on and drive his claymore into it, breaking the platform and forcing players to migrate to a new one to avoid the lava. He will summon a few flame atronachs after teleporting to a new platform. This will continue until no platforms remain. Players should ensure the group has enough damage to kill the boss before all platforms are gone.

abilities.name: Flame Spit
abilities.description: After teleporting, the boss summons a shield around himself that shoots fireballs continuously as long as its up dealing moderate flame damage over time to all players.

abilities.name: Magma Prison
abilities.description: The boss throws rocks at two random players stunning them for a long time. While stunned, players will take moderate flame damage over time. Break free to counter this.

abilities.name: Flame Bolt
abilities.description: The boss will randomly target a player and channel a fireball in one hand that will knock back (called Flame Bolt Knockdown) its target if it hits.

abilities.name: Meteor [verification needed]
abilities.description: Throughout the fight meteors will randomly strike the platform dealing moderate flame damage as indicated by red circles.

dialogue.speaker: Fingaenion
dialogue.line: Gilraen! You look—are you all right?

dialogue.speaker: Fingaenion
dialogue.line: What did they do to you?

dialogue.speaker: Gilraen
dialogue.line: Never mind that. How about you try not getting yourself killed? The Valkyn and his pet Titan—we're going to slay them before they do the same to us.

dialogue.speaker: Valkyn Skoria
dialogue.line: I will see to it the Golden Flame erases you.

dialogue.speaker: Valkyn Skoria
dialogue.line: Your skins will make fine banners!

dialogue.speaker: Monynen
dialogue.line: What is that, up in the sky? It's like no fowl I've ever seen.

dialogue.speaker: Ash Titan
dialogue.line: This is the end of the line. Valkyn Skoria wants you dead.

dialogue.speaker: Valkyn Skoria
dialogue.line: Do you have a deathwish, mortal wretch? You've been complacent for so long—why seek open war now?
dialogue.trigger: When you reach the crossroads in front of the broken bridge during the quest, Skoria will address Gilraen.

dialogue.speaker: Gilraen
dialogue.line: I'm leaving. The deal was my husband and the others would be spared. You violated the Pact, and before the day is done, I will see you dead.
dialogue.trigger: When you reach the crossroads in front of the broken bridge during the quest, Skoria will address Gilraen.

notes: Scoria is a type of volcanic rock.

He wears Xivkyn style heavy armor with an unobtainable chestplate. It is dyed white with red undertones, but due to the magma skin applied to him, the color cannot be seen under regular circumstances.
related_quests: Return to Ash: Enter the Deadlands to rescue a failed invasion force.
Pledge: City of Ash II: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing the City of Ash II.
summary: This article is about the creature. For the item set, see Valkyn Skoria (set). Valkyn Skoria is a minion of Mehrunes Dagon. He leads the attack on the graht-oak city formerly known as Whisper Grove in Greenshade.
